body:
## What is owed

The human ruled on 2026-08-14 (comment on #334, in the interactive decision-clearing session): a finding at **Medium or below** may be adjudicated **accepted and filed** — the implementer agrees it is real, states why the fix does not belong in this diff, and files it on the originating item before landing; not available above Medium, and not where the defect is in the diff under review rather than conditional on named work outside it. The ruling states: *"this amends ADR-0071 ruling 4, a human sign-off gate; this ruling is that sign-off."*

The ruling names four surfaces, and none has landed:

1. **ADR-0071 ruling 4** — the adjudication list gains the fourth route with its restrictions. Routing class 1; the second decision-clearing session's queue item 4 already merges #361's and #368's ADR-0071 amendments into one landing, and this belongs in that same landing rather than opening the ADR a second time.
2. **`docs/agents/review-severity.md`**, "How the levels are used" — the rule and its worked example, because that is the document a reviewer and an implementer actually read. Ungated runbook.
3. **#334's enforcement** — the `just land` refusal must recognise the disposition (already noted on #334's thread, in scope before the check is built).
4. **The review brief's contract** (`tools/brief.py`), wherever it enumerates what an implementer may do with a finding.

## Why this issue exists

The second decision-clearing session's index on #217 says of this execution: *"It is not on the queue above and should be."* Nothing else carries it. Until it is transcribed, a seat meeting an accepted Medium finds only three routes in the documents it reads, and the round-3-prose workaround that prompted the ruling (#356's adjudication) recurs.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] ADR-0071 ruling 4's adjudication list carries the fourth route, its restrictions and the Medium ceiling, in the merged ADR-0071 landing
- [ ] `docs/agents/review-severity.md` carries the rule and the worked example
- [ ] #334's acceptance criteria recognise the disposition
- [ ] The review brief contract enumerates it
- [ ] Each text is derived from the ruling comment on #334, not pasted from a summary
- [ ] `just fast` green

Filed by retro 31 from the ruling on #334 and the index on #217.
title: Transcribe the accepted-and-filed adjudication route into its four surfaces (ruling of 2026-08-14 on #334)
